title: TORAI++ : a post-processing fix for TORAI's aggregation-blindness
protocol: 5 repeats per experiment, following TORAI paper Section 4.2
determinism: TORAI is fully deterministic on RE3 (std = 0 across all 5 runs for every cell)

sanity_check_torai_ob.note: MEM and DISK match exactly; remaining per-fault gap attributable to deployment differences between the authors' Online Boutique and the RE3 Online Boutique

mechanism: TORAI ranks by anomaly severity. In aggregation-heavy systems, a code-level fault in a leaf service produces its loudest anomalies in the aggregator (frontend, checkoutservice), which is a victim, not a cause. TORAI++ re-ranks using the call graph: services with many anomalous callees are penalized.
residual_failure: f5 (Data Corruption) on RE3-OB: TORAI++ reaches AC@1 = 0.833, one case remains wrong
